title: Package removed from CRAN
description:
On [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ichimoku/index.htm)  I get the following message:

> Package ‘ichimoku’ was removed from the CRAN repository.
> 
> Formerly available versions can be obtained from the [archive](https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/ichimoku).
> 
> Archived on 2025-12-17 as issues were not corrected in time , M1-SAN checks
> 
> A summary of the most recent check results can be obtained from the [check results archive](https://cran-archive.r-project.org/web/checks/2025/2025-12-17_check_results_ichimoku.html).
> 
> Please use the canonical form https://cran.r-project.org/package=ichimoku to link to this page.
> 

Are you still planning to maintain the package which I find great and very helpful for ichimoku-based analysis?

title: Enhancement Suggestions for ichimoku
description:
Dear Charlie,

I really like your R package ichimoku and appreciate your work. I have two suggestions:

1. Would it be possible to add a legend to better identify the numerous lines?

2. Could the Kumo Cloud be colored differently? For example, a bullish cloud could be displayed in light green (when Senkou Span A is above Senkou Span B) and a bearish cloud in light red (when Senkou Span B is above Senkou Span A). This would make it easier to differentiate these phases visually. Example: [Ichimoku plot from Wikimedia](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ichimoku_vue_ensemble_fig1.png)

Best regards,
Steve

title: asymmetric strategies not generating entry signals if exit condition not yet met
description:
If I use a type 3 strategy at the end of the chart where the exit condition is not yet met, the entry condition is not triggered either. For type 1 strategies it works as expected. For testing purposes I used a quasi-symmetric type 3 strategy, but saw the same behaviour with real examples.

Here is the code for testing:
```
library(ichimoku)
library(quantmod)
library(dplyr)

# return xts object with daily data for Gold future for the current year;
# yahoo Symbol: "GC=F" and remove all rows with NA
xts_obj <- getSymbols("GC=F", auto.assign = FALSE, from = '2024-01-01', to = '2024-08-12') %>% na.omit()  

# calculate all inidcators for the Ichimoku cloud
cloud <- ichimoku(xts_obj)

# define the symetric strategy: tenkan > kijun 
strat_type_1 <- strat(cloud, c1 = "tenkan", c2 = "kijun", type = 1)

# entry signal generated on July 8
plot(strat_type_1)

# define similar asymetric strategy tenkan > kijun x kijun > tenkan
strat_type_3 <- strat(cloud, c1 = "tenkan", c2 = "kijun", c3 = "kijun", c4 = "tenkan", type = 3)

# entry signal not generated on July 8
plot(strat_type_3)
```

title: `iplot()` fails on CRAN Build 1.3.2
description:
There is a regression bug, which has been fixed in the development version in dc3ee4c.

If using `iplot()` functionality, please either refrain from upgrading to 1.3.2 or install the dev version 1.3.2.9000 using:

```r
install.packages("ichimoku", repos = "shikokuchuo.r-universe.dev")
```
The fix will be incorporated in the next CRAN release. Apologies for any inconvenience caused.

title: Version 1.2.5 binaries for R-oldrel (4.0.x) unavailable on CRAN
description:
This is due to an issue that affects only the archive() function for release 1.2.5 on previous R versions.

If you are having problems with archive() or require binaries, please use build 1.2.99.16 or greater (v1.3 release candidate) from rOpenSci R-universe with:

```r
install.packages("ichimoku", repos = "https://shikokuchuo.r-universe.dev")
```
